public.title: Styled Text Ranges II
public.description: input {length,ranges,edits}; ranges are disjoint sorted [start,end,style] triples where style is a nonempty string. Edits use the same format and overwrite earlier styles on their half-open spans in order; null style removes a style. Endpoints lie from 0 through length, length at most 200. Return sorted nonempty style ranges, merging adjacent equal styles and omitting unstyled positions. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Expand styles onto a bounded position array, apply writes in order and run-length encode. O(length times (ranges plus edits)) time, O(length plus output) space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
